Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He is visibly fighting back a grimace of some kind. His face twists this and that way, until he manages to produce a neutral, if tense, line across his mouth.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: If I have truly done so, then I must apologise. But it was not my intention !

Line.Text: It just so happens to be at the forefront of mes pensées. I have told you why, oui ? It is world politique !

Choices.Text: Do you know who that Kweebec is, then?
